name: migration
summary: Apply the same change across many files: prove it on one, then fan out the recipe

steps.goal: List every unit to migrate and count them
steps.verify: recount the units with a second command

steps.goal: Migrate one representative unit and write the recipe as exact steps another agent can repeat
steps.verify: the pilot unit builds and its tests pass

steps.goal: Apply the pilot's recipe to one batch of units
steps.verify: the batch's own check from the recipe
steps.fan_out: one subtask per batch of units, ids batch-<n>; raise to implement for units the recipe does not fit

steps.goal: Count migrated units against the map and run the project check once
steps.verify: N of N units migrated and the check passes
